connector.name: Lumind
connector.registryDescription: Measure how AI engines cite your brand. Cross-engine GEO visibility, as agent tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at lumind.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.lumind, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Capped agent key as a Bearer token (lmd_agent_...). A human creates it with total and daily caps. Get a key at https://lumind.io/account
